verdict.rationale: Datadog documents an official MCP server and a general-purpose API for programmatic platform access, and its docs describe querying telemetry data via natural language or DDSQL, so an agent has a first-party path to its observability data. However, the pack never shows which MCP tools or API endpoints expose traces, metrics, or LLM evaluation results for reading. The evaluations API shown is for submitting evaluations, not querying them. Missing for 10: documented MCP tools for trace, metric, and eval queries; an explicit read API for evaluation results; hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/

Query infrastructure resources and telemetry data using natural language or DDSQL syntax
